verdict.rationale: Crossmint's general Checkout product documents webhooks for order lifecycle and payment status (crossmint-docs-18), which covers backend subscription to created/updated/fulfilled/canceled-style events for standard checkout orders. However, for the Agent Checkouts product — the one most relevant to 'agent... can subscribe to order lifecycle events' — the docs explicitly state 'no webhooks in v1' and that developers must poll until a terminal state is reached (crossmint-supp-7), a documented limitation from the same first-party source rather than an independent contradiction. missing for 10: webhook/event push support specifically for agent checkout order intents, independent/hands-on confirmation that the general checkout webhooks fire reliably for all lifecycle states, and any evidence of push-based subscription for agent-initiated orders beyond polling.
